name: Floating Action Button
summary: Floating Action Button. Exposes one high-priority contextual action on a native button with extended or compact geometry.

lifecycle.compatibility: Supported contract; the documented compatibility policy applies.
lifecycle.rationale: Supported contract; the documented compatibility policy applies.

api.name: size
api.description: Named semantic size resolved through KERN density and sizing tokens.

api.name: variant
api.description: Named visual hierarchy treatment that preserves the component semantics.

api.name: tone
api.description: Semantic intent that selects coordinated text, icon, border, and surface tokens.

api.name: extended
api.description: Displays the floating action label in addition to its icon.

api.name: loading
api.description:
Suppresses duplicate activation and owns `aria-disabled` while retaining
focus. Use native `disabled` for ordinary unavailability.

api.name: loadingLabel
api.description: Accessible loading copy; defaults to the application or closest scoped option.

keyboard: Tab focuses the native floating action
Enter and Space dispatch the native click behavior
A loading floating action retains focus but suppresses click and form submission
notes: The projected label remains the accessible name in both extended and visually compact modes.
Native type, disabled, form, accessible naming, and description relationships stay on the host button.
Loading owns aria-disabled and a persistent polite status; use native disabled for ordinary unavailability.
KERN avoids ambient browser globals in reusable runtime infrastructure.
Validate the consuming SSR/hydration route, locale, ids and overlay host.

examples.title: Create-record floating action

guidance.useWhen: Reserve <button krnFab> for one high-priority contextual action and keep its visible label meaningful.
guidance.avoidWhen: Do not use Floating Action Button for navigation, multiple equal-priority actions, or consumer-owned aria-disabled state.

commonMistakes: Importing from an undeclared family path or a source implementation file.
Loading only tokens.css instead of the complete styles/kern.css component bundle.
Assuming the documentation SSR build replaces validation of the consuming application.
Use button[krnFab] with a persistent visible label; compact mode hides that label visually but keeps it as the native accessible name.
Keep type, disabled, name, value, form, ARIA relationships, and click on the native host instead of recreating component proxy inputs or outputs.
Use provideKrnFloatingActionButtonOptions for inheritable visual, extended, and loading-copy defaults; reserve a floating action for one high-priority contextual action.
checklist: Import the symbol from its documented owner entrypoint; do not use a deep source import.
Load @kern-ui/angular/styles/kern.css exactly once in the application's global styles.
Provide every required input and keep collection identities stable across updates.
Verify keyboard, focus, visible labels, invalid state, long text, RTL and 200% zoom.
Test the consuming SSR/hydration route when server rendering is enabled.
Use @kern-ui/angular/testing harnesses when a component-specific harness is available.

controls.label: Variant
controls.description: Changes action emphasis without changing its semantics.

controls.label: Tone
controls.description: Communicates neutral, branded, informational, or destructive intent.

controls.label: Size
controls.description: Changes the action target and label size.

controls.label: Extended
controls.description: Shows or hides the text label.

controls.label: Disabled
controls.description: Binds the native disabled attribute and prevents user interaction.

binding.description: Binds disabled directly to the native floating-action host; it is not a component input.

fixtureEffect.label: overflow
fixtureEffect.description: The fixture deliberately exceeds its normal inline size to expose overflow behavior.

fixtureEffect.label: long text
fixtureEffect.description: Northstar enterprise workspace policy configuration with deliberately extended content for wrapping and truncation verification.

exclusions.reason: This localizable action label is stable accessibility copy; interaction/state controls exercise the same component behavior without duplicating every locale string.
